arxiv-2012-10262.title: Matching in size: How market impact depends on the concentration of trading
arxiv-2012-10262.creator: Ilija I. Zovko
arxiv-2012-10262.description: Abstract \dropcap In this paper we provide empirical evidence that large orders suffer greater market impact when matched with multiple trade counterparts than when matched with one or a small number of counterparts. This provides some support for using large in scale (LIS) venues to improve execution performance.

arxiv-2101-11545.title: Sum Uncertainty Relations: Uncertainty Regions for Qubits and Qutrits Journal: International Journal of Theoretical Physics
arxiv-2101-11545.creator: Seeta Vasudevrao, I. Reena, Sudha, A. R. Usha Devi, A. K. Rajagopal
arxiv-2101-11545.description: Abstract We investigate the notion of uncertainty region using the variance based sum uncertainty relation for qubits and qutrits. We compare uncertainty region of the qubit (a 2-level system) with that of the qutrit (3-level system) by considering sum uncertainty relation for two non-commuting Pauli-like observables, acting on the two dimensional qubit Hilbert space.

arxiv-2201-07138.title: A Note on Weyl’s Equidistribution Theorem
arxiv-2201-07138.creator: Yuval Yifrach
arxiv-2201-07138.description: Abstract H. Weyl proved in [ 2 ] that integer evaluations of polynomials are equidistributed mod 1 whenever at least one of the non-free coefficients (namely a coefficient of a monomial of degree at least 1 1 ) is irrational. We use Weyl’s result to prove a higher dimensional analogue of this fact.

arxiv-2203-08487.title: Wavelet methods to study the pointwise regularity of the generalized Rosenblatt process
arxiv-2203-08487.creator: L. Daw, L. Loosveldt
arxiv-2203-08487.description: Abstract We prove that we can identify three types of pointwise behaviour in the regularity of the (generalized) Rosenblatt process. This extends to a non Gaussian setting previous results known for the (fractional) Brownian motion. On this purpose, fine bounds on the increments of the Rosenblatt process are needed. Our analysis is essentially based on various wavelet methods.

arxiv-2204-13879.title: DGBench: An Open-Source, Reproducible Benchmark for Dynamic Grasping
arxiv-2204-13879.creator: Ben Burgess-Limerick, Chris Lehnert, Jürgen Leitner, Peter Corke
arxiv-2204-13879.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ben Burgess-Limerick, Chris Lehnert, Jürgen Leitner, Peter Corke. This paper introduces DGBench, a fully reproducible open-source testing system to enable benchmarking of dynamic grasping in environments with unpredictable relative motion between robot and object. We use the proposed benchmark to compare several visual perception arrangements. Traditional perception systems developed for static grasping are unable to provide feedback during the final phase of a grasp due to sensor minimum range, occlusion, and a limited field of view.

arxiv-2210-10910.title: A Referable NFT Scheme PubID: pubid: 978-8-3503-1019-1/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2210-10910.creator: Qin Wang 1 , Guangsheng Yu 1 , Shange Fu 2 , Shiping Chen 1 , Jiangshan Yu 2 , Xiwei Xu 1
arxiv-2210-10910.description: Abstract Existing NFTs confront restrictions of one-time incentive and product isolation . Creators cannot obtain benefits once having sold their NFT products due to the lack of relationships across different NFTs, which results in controversial profit sharing. This paper proposes a referable NFT solution to extend the incentive sustainability of NFTs.

arxiv-2305-19266.title: Mid-circuit operations using the omg -architecture in neutral atom arrays
arxiv-2305-19266.creator: Joanna W. Lis 1, Aruku Senoo 1, William F. McGrew 1, Felix Rönchen 2, Alec Jenkins 1, Adam M. Kaufman 1
arxiv-2305-19266.description: Abstract We implement mid-circuit operations in a 48-site array of neutral atoms, enabled by new methods for control of the omg (optical-metastable-ground state qubit) architecture present in 171 Yb. We demonstrate laser-based control of ground, metastable and optical qubits with average single-qubit fidelities of ℱ g = 99.968 ​ ( 3 ) % \mathcal{F}_{g}=99.968(3)\% , ℱ m = 99.

arxiv-2307-02822.title: A note on stable toric sheaves of low rank
arxiv-2307-02822.creator: Carl Tipler
arxiv-2307-02822.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Carl Tipler. Kaneyama and Klyachko have shown that any torus equivariant vector bundle of rank r r over ℂ ​ ℙ n \mathbb{C}\mathbb{P}^{n} splits if r < n r<n . In particular, any such bundle is not slope stable.

arxiv-2402-07139.title: Towards Robust Car Following Dynamics Modeling via Blackbox Models: Methodology, Analysis, and Recommendations
arxiv-2402-07139.creator: Muhammad Bilal Shahid, Cody Fleming
arxiv-2402-07139.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Bilal Shahid, Cody Fleming. Abstract The selection of the target variable is important while learning parameters of the classical car following models like GIPPS, IDM, etc. There is a vast body of literature on which target variable is optimal for classical car following models, but there is no study that empirically evaluates the selection of optimal target variables for black-box models, such as LSTM, etc.

arxiv-2403-00009.title: Randomized Control in Performance Analysis and Empirical Asset Pricing
arxiv-2403-00009.creator: Cyril Bachelard, Apostolos Chalkis, Vissarion Fisikopoulos, Elias Tsigaridas
arxiv-2403-00009.description: Abstract The present article explores the application of randomized control techniques in empirical asset pricing and performance evaluation. It introduces geometric random walks, a class of Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, to construct flexible control groups in the form of random portfolios adhering to investor constraints.

arxiv-2501-05405.title: Data-driven methods to discover stable linear models of the helicity injectors on HIT-SIU
arxiv-2501-05405.creator: Zachary Daniel, Alan Kaptanoglu, Chris Hansen, Kyle Morgan, Steven L. Brunton, J. Nathan Kutz
arxiv-2501-05405.description: Abstract Accurate and efficient circuit models are necessary to control the power electronic circuits found on plasma physics experiments. Tuning and controlling the behavior of these circuits is inextricably linked to plasma performance. Linear models are greatly preferred for control applications due to their well-established performance guarantees, but they typically fail to capture nonlinear dynamics and changes in experimental parameters.

arxiv-2509-19549.title: A High-Precision, Differentiable Code for Solar System Ephemerides Journal: PSJ assist ( Holman et al. 2023 ) ; astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) ; astroquery ( Ginsburg et al. 2019 ) ; JAX ( Bradbury et al. 2018 ) ;
arxiv-2509-19549.creator: Ben Cassese, Malena Rice, Tiger Lu
arxiv-2509-19549.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ben Cassese, Malena Rice, Tiger Lu. We present jorbit , a python/ JAX library designed to enable modern data-driven numerical studies of the solar system. Written entirely in JAX , an auto-differentiable and optionally GPU accelerated language behind many current large-scale machine learning efforts, jorbit includes an independent implementation of REBOUND ’s IAS15 integrator and the ability to parse precomputed ephemerides such as the JPL DE series.

pmc-11517237.creator: Organised by: EuroHealthNet
pmc-11517237.description: Across Europe, people are grappling with a multitude of challenges, spanning from the cost of living to housing, food insecurity, climate change, conflicts, and social unrest. These adversities significantly impact individuals’ health and wellbeing, and create the conditions for persisting health inequalities.

pmc-11642216.title: Munich cCT Rule for Patients with Recreational Drug and Ethanol Poisoning
pmc-11642216.creator: Tobias Zellner, Felix Wegscheider, Michael Dommasch, Florian Eyer, Rebecca Dieminger, Sabrina Schmoll
pmc-11642216.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Patients with recreational drug and ethanol poisoning often present with reduced consciousness, coma, or disorientation. It is often unclear if there was recent head trauma. Algorithms to perform cranial computed tomography (cCT) like the Canadian CT Head Rule (CCHR), the National Emergency X-Radiography Utilization Study Head CT Decision Instrument (NEXUS DI), or the New Orleans Criteria (NOC) exist for patients with head trauma. It is unclear whether these algorithms can be applied to this patient collective.

pmc-13082469.title: Case Report of Primary Splenic Angiosarcoma in a Young Patient: A Very Rare and Challenging Disease
pmc-13082469.creator: Chakib Khoury, Christina Said, Maria Azzi, Emanuel-Youssef Dib, Mohamad Othman, Omar Tabbikha, Fadia Elias, Raja Wakim, Harleen Khatra
pmc-13082469.description: IntroductionPrimary splenic angiosarcoma (PSA) is a rare type of angiosarcoma often associated with an unfavorable prognosis. The presenting symptoms are usually nonspecific, adding to the diagnostic difficulty of this disease. Limited cases have been described in younger adults, as most cases have been reported in individuals between 50 and 70 years old.

pmc-13143159.title: Understanding Public Perceptions of Lung Cancer in China: Infodemiology Study of Baidu Index and Weibo Posts
pmc-13143159.creator: Zongyuan Li, Jian Zhang, Yiming Fan, Nan Chen, Lunxu Liu, Andrew Coristine
pmc-13143159.description: BackgroundIn China, lung cancer remains a major public health concern and accounts for a substantial proportion of cancer-related deaths nationwide. However, limited research has examined public perceptions of lung cancer in the digital sphere, where health-related information is increasingly disseminated and accessed.

pmc-13213331.title: Endometriosis‐Associated Ovarian Carcinosarcoma Featuring Well‐Differentiated Adenocarcinoma and Fetal Rhabdomyoma‐Like Mesenchymal Components: An Unusual Case Report—With Molecular Analysis
pmc-13213331.creator: Yuri Narusawa, Shiho Asaka, Tsutomu Muramoto, Saori Konno, Marina Kobayashi, Yukiko Kusama, Takeshi Uehara, Suraiya Saleem
pmc-13213331.description: Ovarian carcinosarcoma typically comprises high‐grade carcinoma and sarcoma components. We report a case of a woman in her 40s with endometriosis‐associated ovarian carcinosarcoma exhibiting an unusual presentation of well‐differentiated adenocarcinoma and rhabdomyosarcoma. The patient underwent bilateral salpingo‐oophorectomy and hysterectomy for tumors in both ovaries.

pmc-13247907.title: Impact of data augmentation size on deep learning-based third lumbar vertebra computed tomography skeletal muscle segmentation performance
pmc-13247907.creator: Xuzhi Zhao, Yi Du, Xianggao Zhu, Yufei Liu, Yanhui Xiao, Huawei Tian
pmc-13247907.description: BackgroundVarious deep learning (DL) models have been proposed for skeletal muscle segmentation at the level of the third lumbar vertebra (L3) on computed tomography (CT) images, typically incorporating data augmentation to improve model robustness and mitigate overfitting. However, the impact of augmentation size on model performance remains unclear.

pmc-13381256.title: Pain perception and attitudes toward life-sustaining treatment in pediatric patients with disorders of consciousness: a survey of Chinese healthcare professionals
pmc-13381256.creator: Chunyan Yang, Meiqi Li, Yufei Xue, Fangting Wang, Wangshan Huang, Xiaochen Liu, Xiangyue Xiao, Xuhang Fan, Feng Chen, Steven Laureys, Haibo Di, Siyu Dai
pmc-13381256.description: BackgroundManaging pain and life-sustaining treatment (LST) for pediatric patients with disorders of consciousness (DoC) presents unique neuroethical dilemmas. This study investigated the attitudes of Chinese healthcare professionals (HCPs) toward pain perception and LST in pediatric DoC, specifically exploring the influence of decision-making perspectives and socioeconomic factors.MethodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted among 656 Chinese HCPs (March–November 2025).

pmc-13398470.title: Spontaneous hepatic tumor regression in an infant with trisomy 18
pmc-13398470.creator: Masashi Hotta, Katsuya Hirata, Shota Inoue, Kohei Higuchi, Eriko Nishi, Kazuko Wada
pmc-13398470.description: hepatic tumor regressed spontaneously after oncologic treatment was deferred due to poor clinical status. A female infant with T18, complicated by a ventricular septal defect and progressive pulmonary hypertension, was born at 37 weeks of gestation. After neonatal intensive care, the patient was discharged at 5 months of age, with home respiratory support via high‐flow nasal cannula.

pmc-13586664.creator: Ali Bagheri, Amir Sam Kianimoghadam, Zahra Ebadi, Abbas Masjedi‐Arani, Maryam Amini‐Fasakhoudi
pmc-13586664.description: BackgroundMultiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurodegenerative disorder associated with diverse physical and psychological challenges. Effective self‐care behaviors are essential for managing symptoms and improving quality of life. Psychological constructs such as self‐compassion and illness perception are key determinants of self‐management in chronic illness.

uslaw-usc-t28-s1413.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part IV (Jurisdiction And Venue); Chapter 87 (District Courts; Venue). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
